source.name: Foot Mercato: L’AS Monaco et la RD Congo sont au cœur d’une grande enquête judiciaire !
source.quote: ce contrat estimé à 4,8 millions d'euros sur trois ans

note: DR Congo state brand on the sleeve of the professional team. Foot Mercato: the contract was signed in June 2025 and is estimated at €4.8m over three years; the club announced the partnership on 24 June 2025 as running until 2028. The Monaco parquet général opened a preliminary inquiry into the partnership (March 2026).
